subject: ESEM: Different rotation options for different EFA sets?

messages.author: bc810b1d0900407f
messages.subject: ESEM: Different rotation options for different EFA sets?
parts:
Hi All,

I would like to ask a quick question regarding ESEM:

https://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/efa.html

This is the model from the webpage:

model <- '
    # efa block 1
    efa("efa1")*f1 +
    efa("efa1")*f2 =~ x1 + x2 + x3 + x4 + x5 + x6

    # efa block 2
    efa("efa2")*f3 +
    efa("efa2")*f4 =~ y1 + y2 + y3 + y4 + y5 + y6

    # cfa block
    f5 =~ z7 + z8 + z9
    f6 =~ z10 + z11 + z12

    # regressions
    f3 ~ f1 + f2
    f4 ~ f3
'

From the page, ' The efa("efa1")* modifier just before f1 and f2 is used to alert lavaan that these two factors belong to the same EFA block. The factors f3 and f4 belong to a different EFA block (named efa2) and will be rotated independently.'

Given that they will be rotated independently, is it possible to set the two EFA blocks to use different rotation methods when using the rotation and rotation.args argument? Or must all the EFA blocks in a model use the same rotation method and arguments?

-- Shu Fai
